review_rulings: Ruling: keep BRep vertex m_ei adjacency array envelope validation before copy — malformed or oversized adjacency must not reach an owning BRep copy — cost if wrong: a valid SDK topology variant that encodes adjacency differently could be rejected.

Ruling: validate every BRep edge-to-trim reference before authorizing a copy, then validate the independent orientation copy before SolidOrientation — pinned OpenNURBS 5 reads the paired trim in IsManifold without a range check — cost if wrong: malformed topology that the SDK intended to recover will be refused earlier.

Ruling: retain early rejection of DeleteEdge/DeleteTrim tombstones — the pinned SDK's IsCorrupt rejects cleared back-pointers before its later deleted-index checks, and the existing copy-plus-validation path rejects the same state — cost if wrong: a different SDK version that permits non-compacted BReps remains unsupported.

Ruling: validate supported archive member owners before Duplicate, surface BrepForm, and signed-placement orientation queries — the readArchive regressions observed these operations before the converter-only gate — cost if wrong: a valid but unlisted native owner class could be refused before its converter runs. The gate still begins after ONX_Model::Read.

Ruling: reject malformed NURBS cage counts, strides, knots and CV/weight values before Explode IsValid/IsoSurface — the pinned SDK does not check finite knot differences before evaluation — cost if wrong: invalid numeric cages are refused; raw ONX_Model::Read allocation remains outside this guard.
